summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I fixed two bugs so `python3 main.py` now prints `Hello, world!`: I changed the import in `main.py` from the nonexistent `greetings` module to `greeter`, and added the missing colon after `def greet(name)` in `greeter.py`. I ran the program to confirm it works cleanly
